reason: I would download the free version on Wi-Fi and see if my child even sticks with it, but I would not pay this month. In our family it is my mother who pays for the child's learning, and she would rather pay for a real teacher or a course she can see than a subscription on my phone.
objection: Our internet is slow and limited and the phone memory is already full, so I am not sure how big the download is, and with a monthly payment I don't know if my child will still use it after the first two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: If the download size was stated and small, and I could give a one-year access as a gift card or code that grandma pays for once, maybe after other parents in our kindergarten Telegram group say their child really learned letters with it.
